bullets.text: dove-colored sky since morning. it never got around to raining. still hasn't.
eighth day at okunoin. duck carries a line about shakti having a will of its own. the cedars agree by not moving. 🕊️
reread a script i wrote in march. couldn't tell you what that person was thinking, but it runs.
twenty-three and overcast. the kind of warm that doesn't ask for anything back.
the fan swings past every four seconds like it's checking i'm still here.
